message.content:
This is a low-confidence guess. The image is entirely grayscale, so the film is almost certainly black-and-white. That leaves Carnival of Souls, Night of the Living Dead, House on Haunted Hill, The Last Man on Earth or The Little Shop of Horrors.

- **Against Carnival of Souls and The Last Man on Earth:** both open with bright daytime scenes, but the barcode starts mid-gray.
- **For Night of the Living Dead:**
  - The barcode is mostly a steady mid-gray with darker stretches, which fits a film set largely inside a house at night.
  - The brighter stripes near the very end fit its daylight morning finale.

The Little Shop of Horrors (mostly mid-gray shop interiors) and House on Haunted Hill (dark night interiors) can't be ruled out.

Answer: C
